description:
5 weird things that tell me you are officially ready to buy… 🏡✨

You think you’re just “browsing,”
but your habits say you’re ready to close.

If you’ve been doing these lately…
𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗼𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗿 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲 😏

1️⃣ 𝗙𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗘𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆
You’re measuring sectionals for a house you haven’t even toured yet. 🛋️

2️⃣ 𝗭𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄 = 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆
You refresh listings more than your own notifications. 📲

3️⃣ 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘁 𝗗𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲
You know all the school ratings… even without kids. 🏫

4️⃣ 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 𝗛𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲 𝗦𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀
Brunch? No thanks. You’re out spotting “𝗹𝗶𝗽𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗸 𝗼𝗻 𝗮 𝗽𝗶𝗴” flips like a pro. 🕵️‍♀️

5️⃣ 𝗗𝗜𝗬 𝗔𝗹𝗴𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗺
Your FYP went from travel reels to “𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗿𝗲𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝗳𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗿𝘀” overnight. 🔨

If your brain is already living in your future house…
𝗟𝗲𝘁’𝘀 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗶𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹. 🗝️

Ready to start your home search?
“𝗠𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝘁’𝘀 𝗴𝗲𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲 🏡✨”
